title.narrative: Support to Development of Oncology Services Project in Uzbekistan - Phase II

description.narrative: In line with SDG3 (Good Health and Wellbeing), the overall objective of the project is to strengthen the preparedness of the healthcare system in Uzbekistan, and prevent and treat oncological cases in an effective and timely manner. UNOPS procures and provides medical, laboratory, radiological and ICT equipment to the Ministry of Health of the Government of Uzbekistan. The project is expected to have a direct impact on the healthcare services being provided to the respective local communities, including vulnerable groups.
